_doc: Field power-distribution design input for tools/field_pdn_design.py (Claude, 11 Oct 2026). One entry per rail: the net (board spelling),
its galvanic domain, the source pads, the design current (tools/power_widths.json) and the load / terminal clusters with a current
share. A cluster current is the DOCUMENTED maximum of that load (basis + citation); a trunk segment carries the sum of the clusters
downstream of it, capped at the rail design current ('at the design current', task brief). Clusters without a document get an even
split of what the documented clusters leave of the design current (basis 'EVEN SPLIT', flagged). Return nets mirror their supply:
the external load current of each terminal block returns through its 0 V terminals; IC ground pins carry only quiescent current.
Field-A AUX supplies (AUX_24V_A/B, AUX_5V_A/B) and the probe supplies (PRB0/1_24V) return through the motor / probe connector 0 V
terminals; the FIELD_5V buck input current returns at the buck GND (counted once, at the buck: conservative).
All values are DESIGN ASSUMPTIONS from the documents cited, not measurements.
